title: Theo Bell
summary: The most feared archon of the Camarilla.

claims.text: Bell was born into slavery on a plantation in early Mississippi and is the childe of Don Cerro.
As archon, Bell has earned the Inner Circle's personal praise seven times, a record, and anarchs in a hundred cities curse the nickname Killa-B.
Bell's one condition for the Embrace was the chance to return to the Bell plantation, and the first hunger led back there to its master.
Robin was a silversmith's apprentice in colonial America, Embraced in 1757 during the French and English war for the continent and then abandoned by the sire.
The sire is named as Alonso Cristo Petrodon de Seville; Robin is of the 7th generation.
Some say Robin's sire was the previous Nosferatu justicar, which would explain the choice of successor; others quickly hush the claim.

title: Polonia
summary: A Lasombra soldier of the Sabbat.

claims.text: Polonia is of the 7th generation, Embraced in 1600 by Anton de Concepcion.
Tall, bearded and soldierly, Polonia favours white or grey and wears a silver crucifix, a gift from Polonia's mother, kept for more than three centuries.

title: Al-Ashrad
summary: The Assamite Amr and great sorcerer of the clan.

claims.text: Al-Ashrad came to the Children of Haqim as a mortal magician, and some of the clan plotted against the newcomer; the Amr was ready and slew the plotters.
Al-Ashrad is pale among the dark-skinned Assamites and wears white robes full of pockets.
A diamond fills al-Ashrad's empty left socket and is said to grant sight beyond sight.
